notes.title: New Dev Log Just Dropped — Join Us on the Hunt for Fun!
notes.notes: [p]I know it's been a little while since you heard from us — but don't worry, we weren't just out for a rip. We've been heads-down, giving it our all on [i]Wild Ice[/i]!  To see what we’ve been cooking up, check out the latest dev log, where we dive into how we’ve been chasing the fun and fine-tuning the gameplay![/p][previewyoutube="4c6lAkLFTPo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you missed the last dev log, no worries — it’s a beauty and totally worth a watch! 🍿 We dive into the enemies you’ll be squaring off against, and give you a peek at the combat systems we’ve been fine-tuning.[/p][previewyoutube="lkzfjInmLdE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Twofer Drop! Dev Log 2 and 3 added to YouTube!
notes.notes:
Here’s the scoop: making an open-world tower defense game is no small task. Check out dev log 2 to see how we overcome some of the challenges:
[previewyoutube=O1q5G7U1p98;full][/previewyoutube]

And then in episode 3, we break down how we keep the player and enemy movement smooth like a saucer pass. From setting up lanes to pathfinding, we’re making sure every move is top shelf:
[previewyoutube=iQ0PI4xHvKk;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!

notes.title: Dev Log #1 Just Dropped! 🏒🔥
notes.notes:
We're stoked to announce that while we've been goin’ full tilt getting this game to the goal line, we've also been [b]documenting it's progress[/b]! You can now go behind the glass for an exclusive look at the twists and turns our journey has taken, and see [b]Wild Ice[/b] progress from your granny's pond hockey to top shelf gong show action!

[previewyoutube=8wtrKNZwbOk;full][/previewyoutube]
This is just the first video with more to follow. We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy watching us bring this wacky hockey world to life!
